title: Lingo_Research_Group at SemEval-2026 Task 9: Evaluating Prompt Variants for Polarization Detection

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated by comparing the model's performance (macro F1-scores, precision, and recall) across 22 different languages to identify cross-lingual disparities, systematic under-prediction of positive labels in certain languages, and the effects of translation-based reasoning on model behavior.

Evaluated through SemEval-2026 Task 9 Subtask 2 (Polarization Classification), which tests the model's ability to correctly identify political groups as the targets of polarizing text on social media.
Evaluated through Subtask 2 by measuring the model's ability to detect multi-label sociolinguistic targets, specifically identifying when polarized text is directed at racial or ethnic groups.
Evaluated through Subtask 2 by measuring the model's ability to accurately identify religious groups as the targets of online polarization.
Evaluated through Subtask 2 by measuring the model's capability to identify gender or sexual identity categories as the targets of polarizing framing and rhetorical animosity.
